description: Land Acquisition - Nawinnapitiya, Poojapitiya D/S Division, Kandy District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex, No. 1358/4, Mathugama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired by the government, including descriptions of the land, extents, boundaries, and procedures for compensation claims. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" specifically addressing "land acquisitions" as defined in Type 4 classification.
